description:
Which tab a call is about. Omitted means the one the trader is looking at —
the same default the chrome's own commands take.

fraction.description:
Divider position in the whole context column, top=0 and bottom=1.
At most six decimal places. The applied position obeys both neighbor floors.

tab_id.description: The tab's id, as `observe.workspace` reports it.

upper_pane_id.description: Stable pane IDs from workspace.summary, in upper/lower order.
